name: Lilac Prose
source: Walk with Tristan through his experience as an addiction survivor. He will confront the world outside with all its noise and chaos. It will inevitably swallow him whole, reshape him, and spit him out. You’ll soon come to realize that his addiction was never a problem; it was a solution.
translation: 与特里斯坦一起回顾他作为毒瘾幸存者的经历。他将面对外面的世界，充满喧嚣和混乱。它不可避免地会把他整个吞掉，重塑他，然后把他吐出来。你很快就会意识到他的毒瘾从来都不是问题；这是一个解决方案。
